title: A Consolidated Deployment Edition of a Microservice Core-Banking Platform: Composing Services by Reference into Three Hosts
abstract: arXiv:2610.30212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Microservices give teams independent deployment and scaling, but each deployed service also reserves compute and adds operational work. This paper examines a second deployment edition of a multi-tenant .NET core-banking platform. The existing edition runs as nine AWS ECS Fargate tasks; the alternative composes the five API services by project reference into one API host, alongside a consumer host and a background host. The service code remains in its original repositories, and both editions continue to be built from the same commits. We describe the composition mechanism, module manifest, start-up checks, request handling and configuration precedence, then compare the editions in an emulation of the AWS deployment. The composed edition exposes all 844 declared operations. Across 47 financial workload cases, both editions produced the same observed outcomes and matching ledgers. translated_title: 微服务核心银行平台的整合部署版本：通过项目引用将服务组合为三个主机
translated_abstract: 微服务为团队提供了独立的部署和扩展能力，但每个已部署的服务也会占用计算资源并增加运维工作。本文研究了多租户.NET核心银行平台的第二个部署版本。现有版本以九个AWS ECS Fargate任务运行；而替代版本通过项目引用将五个API服务组合到一个API主机中，另外还有一个消费者主机和一个后台主机。服务代码仍保留在其原始存储库中，且两个版本继续从相同的提交构建。我们描述了组合机制、模块清单、启动检查、请求处理和配置优先级，然后在AWS部署的仿真环境中对两个版本进行比较。组合后的版本暴露了全部844个声明的操作。在47个金融工作负载案例中，两个版本产生了相同的观察结果和匹配的账本。在跨五种主要类型的读取探测中，231个端点中有230个...
tldr: 本文提出将微服务核心银行平台的五个API服务通过项目引用整合为三个主机的新部署版本，在保持相同代码库和构建的前提下，验证了该组合版本在全部844个操作和47个金融工作负载案例中与原有九任务部署功能等价，从而在保留微服务代码组织优势的同时降低了部署开销。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a consolidated deployment edition of a microservice core-banking platform that composes five API services by project reference into three hosts, demonstrating functional equivalence with the original nine-task deployment across all 844 declared operations and 47 financial workload cases, thereby reducing deployment overhead while preserving the microservice code organization.
